## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slim, redheaded schoolteacher with a pointed, pale face and a thin little body. Her long hair, which is sometimes braided or kept unbraided in a torrent of brightness, has been dyed green in the past and is referred to by her friends as auburn or [Titian](../character/titian.md). She has solemn, big, luminous gray eyes and a pretty nose that features seven prominent freckles. Her cheeks display everchanging roses, occasionally flushing faintly with pink.

## Personality

Driven by intense passions and a rich imagination, this individual often falls into daydreams and admits to being heedless, impulsive, and prone to making mistakes. She possesses a natural talent for public recitation and storytelling, alongside a knack for decorating and writing compositions. Fond of children and remarkably skilled at understanding them, she works hard to achieve her ambitions, including pursuing higher education to learn how to live life to the fullest. Despite her varied abilities, she admits to being vain about her thick hair and forgets her duties when having fun. She also harbors a specific terror of passing through the local haunted wood after dark.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley lost her parents during early infancy and spent her early years in the households of Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md) before entering an asylum at [Hopeton](../codex/places.md#hopeton). At eleven years old, she was brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decided to adopt her. Initially struggling with outbursts over her looks, Anne reconciled with Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and formed a deep friendship with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). At school, she clashed fiercely with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after he mocked her red hair, leading her to break a slate over his head and maintain an academic rivalry with him. Anne mistakenly served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) currant wine during a tea party, temporarily causing Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forbid their friendship until Anne helped save [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from croup. Following a series of dramatic mishaps—including breaking her ankle in a dare, accidentally dyeing her hair green, and falling off a roof—she excelled academically under Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She earned first place on the Queen's entrance exam, attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), and won the Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). However, after Matthew's sudden death from a collapse, Anne gave up her scholarship to remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), whose eyesight was failing.

## Quotes

> "Pretty well. I’m better at looking after children, though. I’ve had so much experience at that. It’s such a pity you haven’t any here for me to look after."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)

> “I think he’s lovely,” said Anne reproachfully. “He is so very sympathetic. He didn’t mind how much I talked—he seemed to like it. I felt that he was a kindred spirit as soon as ever I saw him.”
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)

> "Oh, I don’t mean that sort of a name. I mean just a name you gave it yourself. Didn’t you give it a name? May I give it one then? May I call it—let me see—Bonny would do—may I call it Bonny while I’m here? Oh, do let me!"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P33](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0033)

> "Pretty well. I imagine a good deal, and that helps to pass the time. Of course, it’s rather lonesome. But then, I may as well get used to that."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011)

> "I don’t get cross about other things; but I’m so tired of being twitted about my hair and it just makes me boil right over. Do you suppose my hair will really be a handsome auburn when I grow up?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Anne and Mrs. Allan enjoy a close friendship built on mutual kindness and gentle guidance. After Anne mortified herself by accidentally serving Mrs. Allan liniment-flavored cake, Mrs. Allan warmly comforted her, and she later supported Anne through the grief of Matthew's death. They walk together and share encouraging discussions about teaching, personal ideals, and friendship.

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Anne and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) are bosom friends and inseparable companions who vowed lifelong devotion from their very first meeting in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Their close bond survived an enforced separation after Anne accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) currant wine, and was solidified after Anne helped nurse Diana's sister through severe croup. They walk to school together, share imaginative games, travel together, and support each other through various adventures and mishaps.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Anne's relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) began with fierce hostility when he pulled her hair and called her 'Carrots,' prompting her to break a slate over his head and hold a long grudge. They became intense academic rivals competing for top marks in their Queen's class, though Anne privately regretted her lingering resentment after he rescued her from a sinking boat. Over time, their dynamic softened into a reconciled friendship, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) quietly held romantic infatuation for her.
